user.title: Pico Blaster
user.description: Pick the serial port of the IR stick. The /dev/serial/by-id path is preferred because it survives replugs.

error.cannot_connect: Could not open the serial port. Check that the stick is plugged in and the path is right.
error.not_ir_toy: The device on that port did not answer like an IR Toy (bad version reply or firmware older than v20).
error.kernel_ir_toy: This host's kernel has the ir_toy driver, which claimed the stick as a LIRC device, so no serial port appears. This integration only supports the serial (CDC ACM) mode; use the LIRC device another way.
error.no_port: Choose a port or type a path.

abort.already_configured: This IR blaster is already configured.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not open the discovered IR blaster.

send_ir.name: Send IR code
send_ir.description: Send one IR code (Pronto hex or ir-ctl pulse text) through an IR blaster.

carrier.name: Carrier (Hz)
carrier.description: Carrier frequency; default is the entity option or the Pronto code's frequency.

repeat.name: Repeat
repeat.description: How many times to send the frame.
